Name: SEASONAL CUTE EAST SCARP NYAPU RETEXTURES
Author: AhCuteArt
Description:
[size=4][b]Seasonal Cute East Scarp is finally done![/b][/size]
[color=#D4D4D8]Thanks for being patient, everyone. This project took me a while to finish. I was wondering if I was going to post this mod or not, since I plan to collaborate on the Visual Sweet Mod. However, it’s probably going to take me a while to finish up that collab, and I would like to use my ES seasonal mod now. LOL. I also plan to work on Drawberry's Cute Festival Outfits for East Scarp and Drawberry's Seasonal Cuter Characters for ESR soon. So look forward to those.  [/color]

[size=4][b]Installation [/b][/size]
[color=#D4D4D8]1. [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5787]East Scarp[/url][/color]
2. [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/16045]Seasonal Cute Characters for East Scarp[/url]
3. Pick the CP file or the Manual replacement. DL, unzip, and drop them in your mods folder.

[size=4][b]Extras[/b][/size]
[color=#D4D4D8]The original Seasonal Cute Characters for East Scarp had some extra portraits for Victoria and Eyvinder but the sprite and code were missing... So I added them to my CP file. If you decide to go with the manual replacement many of Victoria and Eyvinder's seasonal portraits won't show up. I also edited a couple of Aideen sprites to better match her outfits. [/color]

[color=#D4D4D8][i]Small Note: I couldn't test Jasper and Eyvinder's seasonal outfits. My test file has not seen the events that allow them to show up. So please let me know if there are any issues. I'll try my best to fix them. [/i][/color]

[size=4][b]Credits[/b][/size]
[color=#D4D4D8]The biggest of thank yous to [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/54606682]nyapu[/url] for being an amazing artist and for allowing so many of us modders to use their work.[/color]
[color=#D4D4D8]I will always be grateful to [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/1249127]DolphinIsNotaFish[/url] for teaching me how to code my own mods. [/color]
[color=#D4D4D8]Thank you  [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/68088657]lemurkat[/url] for creating and maintaining East Scarp and giving me permission to retexture Seasonal Cute Characters for East Scarp.[/color]
[color=#D4D4D8]Thanks  [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/2679113]Poltergeister[/url] for creating the Seasonal Cute Outfit Series. [/color]
[color=#D4D4D8]Thank you earthtosyd for giving me your Seasonal Portrait Backgrounds frame edit.  [/color]

[color=#D4D4D8]Thank you to the multiple artists that designed and created the seasonal outfits for the ES characters. [/color]
[color=#D4D4D8]Portrait Credits: Poltergeister, Airyn, Nin, Ailin.
Original Artists:  Hadi, HimeTarts,Corinne, Lemurkat, PaperNautilus, Attonbomb, Penquin, ItsBenter, Rafsaez, FellowClown, Lore[/color]

[size=4][b]Shout outs[/b][/size]
[size=3][color=#D4D4D8]Say thanks to anyone who inspired or helped you.[/color][/size]
